technique_name: Suggest a data visualization technique to visualize the given dataset.
description: A line chart would be a suitable data visualization technique to visualize the given dataset. A line chart allows visualizing the trend of the data points over a period of time which is ideal for visualizing sales data. The line chart clearly demonstrates the sales trend over the months, including any sudden spikes or drops in the sales.
example: [Dataset containing the sales of a product in each month for the past year]
